# 不要只测一次：衡量AI搜索中的可见度（GEO）

**原题：Don't Measure Once: Measuring Visibility in AI Search (GEO)**  
**作者：**Julius Schulte、Malte Bleeker、Philipp Kaufmann；圣加仑大学（瑞士），前者属Global Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation，后两位属Marketing und Customer Insight；Schulte另与Aurora Intelligence关联。  
**版本：**arXiv:2604.07585v1，2026年4月8日；首页署4月10日，19页。清单的长题名是另一表述，本稿采用PDF实际题名。  
**状态：**全文翻译与详细教学初校，正文1—7、附录A—L、17表7图、公式与完整书目保留；未复现实验。论文中的“7次/8次”“2—4周”是特定数据的经验结果，不是任意品牌的精度保证。

## 第一部分：全文中文译文

### 摘要

基于LLM的聊天系统广泛使用后，生成式引擎优化成为信息获取与检索的重要问题。传统搜索相对透明稳定，一次查询通常能代表页面或品牌相对竞争者的位置；AI搜索的概率性质改变了这一点。回答跨运行、提示和时间变化，一次观察不可靠。本文实证结果强调反复测量，应该将品牌GEO表现描述为分布，而非单点结果。

关键词：AI可见度、GEO、SEO、信息检索。

### 1 引言

LLM改变消费者检索方式，挑战传统搜索生态，而搜索仍是多数企业基础营销沟通渠道。作者举出市场变化：Google在西方长期占主导，2024年末市场份额出现十年来首次下降；ChatGPT周活从2024年1月约1亿升到2025年9月约7.8亿；另有研究估计四年内可能超越Google。消费者也越来越让AI代理购物、规划、编码等。**这些是原文引用的历史数字与预测，非本稿当前市场核验。**

监测方式同样改变。传统SEO有Google Search Console等第一方工具；转向GEO带来可观察性缺口，模型提供方在论文写作时没有同等原生监测工具，具体查询及查询量不能直接观察。

缺乏真实基准时，营销者采用替代方法，测品牌在生成回答中的提及频率与显著程度，即可见度。但生成系统随机，只看静态可见度不够。本文将**稳定性**作为互补维度，提醒新兴第三方工具提供的快照可能造成过早判断；须考察跨时间与提示变体的一致性。

### 2 文献

Padilla等2025用点击流发现，采用AI搜索后传统搜索查询渐进减少超过20%，信息型/问题型需求降幅尤大，提示生成搜索可能替代复杂知识需求中的传统检索。

GEO评价已有位置调整引用显著性、主观来源相关性、品牌域名出现和引用来源可见度等，指标由点击转向曝光。难点是系统架构不透明，企业无法精确预测品牌何时如何出现。相较SEO位置变化，GEO经常出现“纳入或完全排除”的动态。Wen等强调GEO关注回答中的纳入和显著性；概率token生成、检索证据筛选把多来源压缩到有限答案空间，增大波动。

本文响应对更好追踪的呼吁，除测可见度，还量化跨提示、跨行业稳定性，补充此前未明确实证量化波动的研究。

### 3 方法与数据

两份数据：第一份为四AI引擎、四个瑞士德语主题活动的每日结果，采集范围2026年1月24日至3月20日，活动有45—46个有记录日；第二份在相近日内反复提交相同提示，尝试分离随机波动与时间漂移。**日期跨度与有效采集日数不同，不将45—46误写为连续日历跨度。**

提示从高SEO搜索量关键词出发，用Google“People Also Ask”生成相关问题，每活动8条。作者引用行业研究称70%的AI搜索用户用漏斗顶部问题了解产品/服务，且使用更会话化表达，因此以此近似用户行为。四主题为电信、房产出售、体育用品、消费电子，均为瑞士SEO常见领域；每题提交ChatGPT、Gemini、Google AI Mode、Perplexity。完整德语、英文、中文对照在附录。原德语活动名见附录A。

### 5 结果二：短时间重复运行

日间变化可能来自算法或索引。作者比较同一日重复相同问题，以分离模型内在随机性，认为单日变化很可能来自概率生成或该引擎输出系统。

独立采集每活动8题、四引擎、每题最多10次连续运行。部分引擎跨日：ChatGPT3月21—23，Perplexity23，Gemini22—23，AI Mode24—25。只比较时间差≤24小时的配对。来源分析再要求每次至少提取到1条引用，排除零引用导致的假零分；总体75.4%运行通过，ChatGPT仅42.2%，作者解释其在定义型问题常不启动网页搜索。过滤后有3,409对来源比较。

若按传统搜索直觉，几分钟内同题应高度重合；实际来源J=.32—.43，与日间相近，作者据此认为日内随机性解释大部分不稳定。

### 6 限制

**采集质量。**ChatGPT数据混入images.openai.com图片CDN伪域名，共889次，占ChatGPT P2引用5.8%。混合API与界面会造成该引擎口径不一致，因此作者称分析限制在1月24日至3月20日一致采集窗口，并过滤该域名；未来需固定采集方式和模型版本。这里“全部分析限于该窗口”应结合另有3月21—25重复集阅读，原文措辞不完全一致。

**瑞士环境。**全部服务器在瑞士，IP和locale可能影响地理个性化索引、语言权重与引用，不能直接外推其他区域语言。

**重复集窗口。**原始数据还含Google AI Overviews（3月22—23），它是普通搜索结果的AI摘要，与专门AI界面不同，全部排除。只保留四引擎≤24小时配对。ChatGPT57.8%运行无引用，来源相似度对所有引擎都排除零引用，试图测真实重合而非采集失败。

**品牌检出。**固定词表对子串匹配，可能漏同义名、缩写、转述，也可能因通用子串产生误报。70%资格阈值缓解但不能消除问题。

### 7 结论与操作含义

AI可见度不应像确定性SEO排名一样看待。生成搜索会纳入/排除品牌，即使同题短期重复也波动；日间来源重合34—42%，品牌45—59%，方差宽，单次可能高估或低估真实出现率。应将表现定义为重复运行中的提及概率。

- **最少运行次数。**10次重复数据的收敛分析：品牌n=7时SE<.10，95%半宽±.158；n=8时SE<.08，半宽±.121。来源覆盖SE<.10需8次。作者建议每题每天至少7次监测品牌，关注来源覆盖至少8次。
- **多问题。**问题间J从<.2到>.8，一两题只代表自身，应有多样提示组合。
- **持续窗口。**品牌滚动收敛分析称10天SE<.10，24天<.05；21天半宽±.105、28天±.065。建议2—4周滚动，分辨持续可见度与瞬时波动。**原表17的10天SE=.107，实际不低于.10，此冲突照实保留。**
- **分活动/引擎基线。**引用集中度不同，不用统一阈值套所有产品。
- **品牌与来源分开。**品牌跨日更稳定，可作为活动级KPI；具体URL监测仍用于理解哪些内容推动纳入。

未来应检验其他语言地区，以及结构内容、权威外链等干预能否持久改变品牌纳入概率。

### 附录 D Jaccard

有限无权集合相似度，广用于信息检索、生物学：

\[
J(A,B)=\frac{|A\cap B|}{|A\cup B|}=\frac{|A\cap B|}{|A|+|B|-|A\cap B|}.\tag{1}
\]

0≤J≤1；不相交为0；非空集合完全相同为1。两空按本研究C政策排除。

### 附录 E 排名偏置重合RBO

RBO用于排名列表，而非只看集合；高位权重大，可处理不同长度、不同项目的列表。按深度d的重合，用持续参数p几何衰减：

\[
RBO(S,T,p)=(1-p)\sum_{d=1}^{\infty}p^{d-1}A_d,\tag{2}
\qquad A_d=\frac{|S_{:d}\cap T_{:d}|}{d}.\tag{3}
\]

S/T是列表，0<p<1，p越大越重视尾部；(S_{:d}\)与(T_{:d}\)为前d项集合。

有限列表需截断。本文使用非外推最小界：k取较短长度，超过k的重合假定0：

\[
RBO_{min}(S,T,p)=(1-p)\sum_{d=1}^{k}p^{d-1}A_d,\qquad k=\min(|S|,|T|).\tag{4}
\]

完全相同且长k时得到 (1-p^k\)，不是1。p=.9、k=5时约.41，即使顺序完全相同也如此。它是保守下界，因为未观察尾部重合只会增加分数。作者认为列表长短不同，不外推可避免无依据假设；计算前先去重以满足包要求。

J只看有没有相同项目；RBO还看位置重要性。使用Changyao Chen的Python实现，PDF脚注实际链接为 https://github.com/changyaochen/rbo 。本稿没有运行该项目。

### 附录 I Gini公式、例子与实现

#### I.1 公式

Gini测分配不均；作者写G=0为各域名相等，G=1为单域名占全部。将n个非负引用量升序排为 (y_1\le\cdots\le y_n)：

\[
G=\frac{2\sum_{i=1}^n i y_i}{n\sum_{i=1}^n y_i}-\frac{n+1}{n}.\tag{5}
\]

(y_i)为域名引用数，i为升序位次；它等价于Lorenz曲线与平等线间面积的两倍，排序后只需一次遍历。**校读：这个有限样本未校正形式在一域名占全、其余为0时上限为(n−1)/n，非严格1；原文端点是常见极限性解释。**

#### I.2 完整算例

五域名引用[1,2,3,4,10]，排名[1,2,3,4,5]。总量20，加权和1×1+2×2+3×3+4×4+5×10=80：

\[
G=\frac{2\times80}{5\times20}-\frac65=1.6-1.2=.4.
\]

作者称中度不均：最大域名占50%，其余四个不均分剩余50%。

## 第二部分：面向小白的详细讲解与教学

以下是译者根据论文设计的理解练习，不是作者做过的额外实验，演示品牌、数据均为虚构。

### 1 这篇解决的不是“怎样被推荐”，而是“怎样知道自己真的进步”

假设你经营“青禾”跑鞋，今天问AI“新手跑鞋推荐”，回答有你；明天再问没有。你不能仅凭第二次说“内容更新失败”，因为页面没变，模型仍会抽到不同来源、不同答案。论文用两种观察区分：连续多天看相邻日，短窗口同题再问多次。两种都波动，说明只挑一个截图做GEO成绩单很危险。

能落地的核心动作是先建立重复测量，再改内容。否则即使页面改进有效，也可能被随机一次未提及遮住；无效改动也可能碰巧出现，被错当成功。

### 2 四个指标各回答什么？

|指标|小白问题|不能回答的事|
|---|---|---|
|品牌提及率|重复问相同题，有几次出现青禾？|出现是否正面、是否推荐、是否正确|
|来源Jaccard|两次答案引用的是不是同一批来源？|先后次序和链接质量|
|RBOmin|前部来源重合多少，并受短列表上限约束？|单独区分排序变化和长度变化|
|Gini|所有引用是否集中在少数域名？|集中域名是否真实、是否值得相信|

“一次回答里出现了青禾”是0/1观察；十次出现6次得到样本提及率.6，而不是证明真实概率恰好60%。品牌出现和你的官网被引也不是一回事：AI可能从媒体文章提品牌，或引官网但没有写品牌名称。

### 3 手算Jaccard，别把65%误读成替换率

第一次引用A、B、C、D、E；第二次A、B、C、F、G。交集3个，并集7个，所以J=3/7=.429。第一次的5条有2条被替换，替换率2/5=40%；1−J=.571却是并集内4个非共有元素/7。

两者分母不同。要说“原有来源留住多少”，另算交集/第一次列表长度；要照论文复算，仍用J，不擅自用留存率替代论文表格。报告时写明“Jaccard重合度”，避免口头改称“留存百分比”。

### 4 RBO为何两个完全相同答案还只有.41？

论文p=.9，前五个深度权重依次.1、.09、.081、.0729、.06561，加起来.40951。两列都完全相同，每层Ad=1，于是RBOmin仍为.40951；剩余.59049的尾部权重没有观察，最小界当0。

因此表2中RBO约.2低于J约.35，既可能有排序变化，也可能是列表较短。不能只比较这两个数字就说“顺序大幅变化”。若做内部诊断，可另外在相同长度下比较，或补充外推/规范化版本，但必须单独命名，不能拿新算法结果与论文原RBOmin当同一指标。

练习：两份完全相同的10条列表，RBOmin=1−.9^10≈.6513，仍小于1。条目更多本身就提高可达到的最大值。

### 5 为什么不能直接宣传“问7次就准了”？

作者只有每组10次，把其中7次取出来，反复形成子样本。因为每个子样本和参考10次高度重叠，抽到9次时只漏一个，差异天然很小。作者自己提醒这是有限总体下界。

给出另一个纯数学演示：若每次真是独立伯努利，真实提及率p=.5，新取n=7次的样本均值SE为√(.5×.5/7)≈.189；n8约.177。它们明显大于本文不放回经验平均.081/.062，因为问题和计算口径不同。不能把论文平均SE当任何新品牌、新引擎的通用置信区间。

“7次品牌、8次来源”可作为这份研究给的起步参考，不能保证“差5个百分点也测得出”。想识别小改进，需要预先定最小有意义变化，并用自身数据估变异。十次全无也不能证明永远不会出现：若真实概率10%，独立10次全不出现的概率仍是.9^10≈34.9%。

此外10次有45个两两配对，但45对共享那10条回答，不是45次独立试验。不要把配对数当独立样本数硬缩小误差；正式推断应考虑提示、日期、引擎内聚类。

先固定一个业务、一个地区与一个语言，不要今天北京中文，明天瑞士德语，再合成一个“品牌分”。每条原始回答一行：

### 7 先排除数据故障，再谈没被引用

一条没有来源链接的回答可能是合法的非联网回答，也可能是采集失败。分成：成功且有引用、成功且无引用、抓取失败/超时。前两类能讨论引擎是否调用搜索；第三类应补采或报告缺失，不能记作品牌未提及。

本文重复来源分析只保留至少1引用，ChatGPT通过率42.2%。因此它回答的是“有引用的运行之间稳定吗”，没有直接测“所有运行的引用稳定性”。实际表应同时列联网/引用激活率与条件相似度，否则只留下漂亮的有引用答案，用户却在大量真实运行中看不到来源。

品牌匹配至少人工检查小样：中文别名、英文名、品牌同名普通词。“On”若简单小写子串匹配，可能在普通英文中误中；青禾也可能被写成集团公司名称。词表记录规范品牌、别名、匹配方式，出现歧义时人工判定。不要把“没有匹配到字符串”等同于“语义上没有提品牌”。

### 8 一个两阶段实操练习

**第一阶段：先测波动。**选8条真实问题，固定环境；按可用成本对每条重复多次，8次可参考但不是精度承诺。保留每次回答，算每题每引擎的品牌提及率、引用激活率及来源J。预算有限先覆盖最关键提示，明确样本小，不为了凑论文数字擅自调用收费接口。

**第二阶段：观察持续性。**选固定每天时段持续2—4周作为论文启发的窗口，记录节假日、模型版本、网页更新。先给每日值，再给7/14/28天滚动值，不用滚动平滑隐藏真实下降。本文十天表中SE=.107，与“<.10”文字矛盾；我们以表数字为准，不沿用错误阈值。

假设改稿前青禾在64次回答中出现24次，改后出现32次，样本率从37.5%到50%。这是描述性上升12.5个百分点，还不能说改稿造成：提示构成、引擎升级、同期竞争者活动都可能变。固定提示、环境、候选业务范围，保留未改对照页或主题，观察变化是否持续；正式统计要匹配设计，不能把前后总和一比就称因果。

24小时减少长期更新影响，但不能保证24小时内无外部变化。作者“多数是随机性”的解释有启发性，却没有完整因果分解出模型随机与索引更新各占多少。

### 9 Gini高，是不是只能投大媒体？

不是。Gini描述这一批查询的引用分布集中：少数域名拿多数引用。但它没证明付钱买大媒体就能提升你，也没判断域名质量。现实动作是先找与你的真实问题相关、常被引用的证据类型，再检查自己内容是否能提供可核验答案。不能把相关观察升级成推广承诺。

想复核集中度，先明确按域名还是URL、同答案重复引用算几次、是否过滤CDN。分母与去重口径不同，Gini也会变。本论文未给完整所有域名频次表，不要凭热图逆推出“前十域名具体份额”。

### 10 学完后的交付清单与自测

应能交出：固定问题清单、环境/时间记录、每次原答、品牌词表及人工误报检查、缺失与无引用分开统计、每题/引擎提及率与跨运行波动、滚动窗口图，以及注明局限的变化解释。

自测一：一次未出现能证明优化失败吗？不能。自测二：J=.35等于旧来源65%被换掉吗？不一定，分母不同。自测三：RBOmin=.41一定很不稳定吗？不一定，五条完全一致也得到约.41。自测四：7次平均SE=.081能保证我的新品牌精度吗？不能，有限10次子抽样和跨序列平均限定了结论。自测五：两周比一天更稳，就证明内容改稿有效吗？不能，测量可靠性和因果效果是两个问题。

Literature
Recent empirical research provides behavioural evidence highlighting the shift from traditional search to generative
search. Using click-stream data, Padilla et al. (2025) show that adoption of AI-based search engines leads to a gradual
but substantial decline in traditional search. Specifically, traditional search queries fell by more than 20% after generative
search adoption, with particularly strong reductions in informational and question-based searches (Padilla et al., 2025).
This suggests that generative search increasingly acts as a substitute for traditional search engines, particularly for
complex or knowledge-seeking queries.
This shift towards AI search requires marketers to change their performance measurement. Research offers marketers
insights into how GEO performance can be measured. Aggarwal et al. (2024) indicate that GEO performance can be
evaluated using visibility (impression) metrics, such as position-adjusted citation prominence and subjective relevance
of sources within generative engine responses. This aligns with Chen et al. (2025), who argue that GEO visibility
can be assessed through domain (brand) presence and citation-based source visibility within AI-generated responses.
Therefore, a shift from click-based metrics to visibility occurs (Rejón-Guardia et al., 2025).
However, quantifying visibility as a GEO performance metric presents inherent challenges due to the intransparent
architectures of generative search engines. These models function as "black boxes", restricting a firm’s ability to predict
precisely when or how its brand will be referenced. Whereas SEO visibility typically oscillates along a deterministic
ranking spectrum, GEO visibility is subject to far greater instability. LLM-generated responses often exhibit a binary
inclusion-exclusion dynamic, where a source is either prominently integrated or omitted entirely. As Wen et al. (2025)
articulate, "unlike SEO, which competes for ranked link positions, GEO focuses on inclusion and prominence within
LLM-generated answers" (Wen et al., 2025, 2). This phenomenon is driven by the probabilistic nature of token
generation and retrieval-augmented evidence selection processes that compress information from diverse sources into a
constrained answer space, thereby increasing visibility volatility (Aggarwal et al., 2024).
As prior research calls for improved tracking of LLM search outputs and brand visibility within generative engines
(Wen et al., 2025), this study extends existing work by focusing not only on the measurement of GEO visibility but
also on the stability and consistency of this visibility across prompts and verticals. Thereby, it expands previous GEO
visibility papers (e.g., (Aggarwal et al., 2024)) that do not explicitly measure or empirically quantify GEO visibility
fluctuation.

The stability of AI-based search engine results is measured along two dimensions: differences in cited sources and

Limitations
Several data-quality and methodological limitations should be noted when interpreting the results.
ChatGPT data collected contained images.openai.com — an OpenAI image-delivery CDN — as a spurious domain
data (889 occurrences, 5.8% of ChatGPT P2 citations). Because mixing API and interface data would create a
methodological inconsistency for ChatGPT specifically, all analyses in this paper are restricted to the January 24 –
March 20, 2026 window, where collection is consistent across all four engines. The images.openai.com domain is
additionally filtered from all calculations. Future studies should pin collection method and model version across the full
observation window.
Swiss-server context. All data were collected from servers located in Switzerland. Prompts are therefore served with
Swiss IP addresses and locale settings, which may affect geo-personalised index selection, language weighting, and
citation patterns. Results may not generalise to other regional or linguistic markets.
Simultaneous-run collection window. The geo-brand-monitor simultaneous collection spanned multiple calendar
days for some engines (ChatGPT: Mar 21–23; Perplexity: Mar 23; Gemini: Mar 22–23; Google AI Mode: Mar 24–25,
2026). The raw dataset additionally contains responses from Google AI Overviews (“Google AIO”, Mar 22–23), a
distinct Google product that generates AI-summary snippets within regular search results rather than operating as a
dedicated AI search interface. Because Google AIO differs fundamentally in interaction mode and citation behaviour
from the four dedicated AI search engines in the study, it is excluded from all analyses; the study focuses on ChatGPT,
Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Perplexity. The analysis further controls for multi-day collection by including only
pairs whose timestamps are within 24 hours of each other; all cross-day pairs exceeding this window are discarded.
Additionally, ChatGPT activates web search only for specific queries, leaving 57.8% of its runs with zero citations; the
source-similarity analysis therefore excludes zero-citation runs across all engines to ensure comparisons reflect genuine
source overlap rather than collection failures.

Conclusion
The research demonstrates that visibility in AI search is inherently unstable and cannot be treated like traditional
SEO rankings. In contrast to SEO, where results may shift in position but typically remain present in the ranking set,
generative search operates on an inclusion–exclusion dynamic in which brands or sources may appear in one response
and disappear entirely in another. Even when identical prompts are executed simultaneously under controlled conditions,
cited sources and brand mentions vary substantially. Source sets overlap by only 34–42% between consecutive days;
brand sets somewhat more, at 45–59%, but with wide variance. As a result, single observations of AI visibility are
misleading and risk over- or underestimating true brand presence.

Instead of relying on snapshot metrics, marketers must conceptualize GEO performance as the probability of being
mentioned across repeated runs. This shift from deterministic rankings to probabilistic visibility fundamentally changes
how marketing performance in AI search should be monitored and managed. Several concrete implications follow:
• Minimum run count. A single daily query cannot provide a reliable estimate of true visibility. A bootstrap
convergence analysis on the 10-run simultaneous dataset (Appendix J) shows that the standard error of the
estimated per-brand detection rate drops below 0.10 at n = 7 runs (95% CI ±0.158) and below 0.08 at n = 8
runs (95% CI ±0.121). For source coverage the convergence is slower: SE < 0.10 requires n = 8 runs,
reflecting higher source-level stochasticity. Practitioners should therefore use at least 7 runs per prompt per
day for brand visibility monitoring, and at least 8 runs when source-level coverage matters.
• Multi-prompt coverage. Prompt-level Jaccard scores vary widely within campaigns (from below 0.2 to above
0.8). Monitoring based on one or two prompts will reflect the idiosyncrasies of those prompts rather than
campaign-level visibility. A large prompt portfolio of diverse queries is advisable.
• Sustained observation windows. Day-to-day source instability (≈65% turnover) means short observation
windows, e.g. days to a week, are insufficient to distinguish signal from noise. A per-brand rolling-window
convergence analysis on the temporal dataset (Appendix K) shows that the standard error of a d-day per-brand
detection rate estimate drops below 0.10 at d = 10 days and below 0.05 at d = 24 days (95% CI ±0.105 at
d = 21; ±0.065 at d = 28). Short windows that appear precise at the campaign level are substantially noisier
when tracking individual brands. Rolling aggregation over two to four weeks is therefore recommended to
obtain per-brand estimates that are both statistically stable and representative of sustained visibility rather than
momentary snapshots.
• Campaign-specific benchmarking. Citation concentration (Gini ≈0.71 on average) varies meaningfully
across both campaigns and engines. Google AI Mode concentrates citations most strongly; Perplexity
distributes them most evenly. Marketers should set engine-specific visibility baselines rather than applying a
single threshold across all AI search products.
• Brand vs. source monitoring. Brand-level day-to-day stability (Jaccard 0.45–0.59) exceeds source-level
stability (0.34–0.42), suggesting that brand presence aggregated over a campaign is a more reliable KPI than
tracking individual cited URLs. Source-level monitoring remains valuable for understanding which content
pieces drive inclusion.

Convergence Analysis: How Many Runs Are Sufficient?
J.1
Motivation and Method
The stochastic nature of LLM outputs means that a single query yields only a noisy snapshot of a brand’s true visibility.
This is analogous to the pass@k problem in code generation, where Chen et al. (2021) show that estimating the
probability of a correct solution requires multiple independent samples. Lior et al. (2025) formalise this for general
LLM evaluation via the method of moments, deriving the number of repeated runs needed for reliable evaluation.

Don’t Measure Once: Measuring Visibility in AI Search (GEO)
Mizrahi et al. (2024) similarly find that single-prompt LLM evaluation is unreliable and recommend multi-prompt,
multi-run designs. We apply the same logic to GEO measurement, asking: how many repeated runs are needed to
estimate brand-mention probability reliably?
The minimum-run-count recommendation in the Conclusion (Section 5) is derived empirically from the 10-run
simultaneous dataset. The full dataset contains 128 engine–prompt groups (4 engines × 8 prompts × 4 campaigns) with
all 10 runs available. Brand analysis is restricted to the three qualifying campaigns (96 groups; see Section 4); source
coverage analysis uses all 128 groups. We treat the 10-run mean as the best available proxy for the “true” detection
probability.
Method: subsampling without replacement. For each group and subsample size n ∈{1, . . . , 9}, we draw 2,000
random subsamples of size n without replacement (Efron and Tibshirani, 1994) and record the mean binary detection
indicator for each individual brand (1 if that specific brand was detected in the response, 0 otherwise). Rather than
collapsing to a campaign-level “any brand” indicator, we treat each canonical brand as a separate series. Brands that
are never detected across all 10 runs are excluded (their SE is trivially zero and not informative). This yields 1,216
per-brand series across the three qualifying campaigns. The standard deviation of the 2,000 subsample means is the
estimated SE of an n-run estimate for that brand; we report the mean SE across all 1,259 series. Note that sampling
without replacement introduces a finite population correction: at n = 9 from N = 10 runs, the SE is mechanically
smaller than it would be for truly independent additional runs. The reported SE values therefore represent a lower
bound; actual SE from fresh data would be somewhat higher at large n.
Source coverage. We measure how well an n-run union of cited domains approximates the 10-run reference union,
using Jaccard similarity between the two. We draw 2,000 subsamples per group and report SE of this Jaccard across all
128 groups.

K.1
Motivation and Method
The sustained-observation-window recommendation in the Conclusion is derived empirically from the temporal dataset
(Jan 24 – Mar 20, 2026). Mirroring Appendix J, we use a per-brand approach: for each canonical brand in the three
qualifying campaigns, we build a daily binary series (1 if that brand was detected in the day’s response, 0 otherwise).
Brands never detected across the entire observation period are excluded. This yields 1,726 per-brand series (3 qualifying

series.
We ask: as the rolling window length d increases, how precisely can a practitioner estimate the underlying per-brand
detection probability from a d-day mean?
For each series and each possible d-day consecutive window within its observation period, we compute the mean
detection rate. The standard error (SE) across all such window means, averaged over all 1,726 series, quantifies
estimation uncertainty as a function of window length d. This follows the same logic as rolling-window volatility
estimation in time-series analysis.
